campaign.name: E-GLUE pair gluing using code-calculus v0.2 glue transformers

direction.hypothesis: Using code-calculus v0.2's E-GLUE transformer (glued distance from class pairs, with factor witnesses carried through the seam) on pairs of small CSS codes with n <= 60 yields board-advancing glued codes, where v0.1 E-GRAFT found 0 survivors.

bar.note: any glued child that is nondominated on the CSS board

direction.feasibility: E-GLUE is admitted as a conditional cell with a transformer at exact distance; the consumer carries factor witnesses through the seam and computes glued distance from class pairs.

novelty.claim: A CSS code obtained by gluing two board entries via E-GLUE

direction.expected_value: A board-advancing glued code would be the first construction-family survivor from a calculus glue move on this board.

abandon_criterion.note: drop if no glued child passes the gate across 1000 pairs

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That gluing two CSS codes does not land on the frontier at these sizes, consistent with v0.1's E-GRAFT result, and that the glue move's value lies elsewhere.

campaign.notes: Uses code-calculus-dev E-GLUE. Pair selection and seam qubits are enumerated by the run script.
